entities.summary: Engalaguppe Seetharamiah Venkataramiah was the 19th Chief Justice of India, serving from 19 June 1989 until his retirement on 17 December 1989. He began his legal career in 1946, and was appointed as a judge of Karnataka High Court in November 1970.
